verdict.rationale: Runloop documents several first-party ways to run it without a UI. Its `rli` CLI offers traditional commands alongside the interactive TUI, benchmark jobs can be submitted from the CLI, it ships SDKs for its API, and an official deploy-agent GitHub Action automates deployment from GitHub workflows. Together these deliver headless and CI automation. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, documentation of non-interactive CLI auth and CI configuration beyond the GitHub Action, and CI integrations other than GitHub Actions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Runloop’s [deploy-agent GitHub Action] automates agent deployment directly from your GitHub workflows.
The Runloop CLI (`rli`) provides both an interactive terminal UI and traditional CLI commands for managing your Runloop resources.
Submit a benchmark job via the CLI and let Runloop handle everything: provisioning devboxes, running agents, scoring results, and aggregating outputs.
Runloop provides SDKs in common languages to interact with the Runloop API.
